holderQuote: And Wailant kicked Numbtongue in the balls. The [Goblin Soulbard] folded up, as his entire head went blank with agony. Wailant stood over him. Numbtongue was a Redfang Warrior, but even Goblins had limits on the pain they could take. He curled up as Wailant guffawed.
effectQuote: The punch coming for Numbtongue vanished. Numbtongue blinked—

holderQuote: The two charged at each other. Seborn was smaller than Wailant by a good bit, but he ducked and punched, retreating as Wailant swung and grabbed a chair. One was big and fast, the other nimble and faster. But Wailant caught Seborn with a kick that sent him skidding away. Seborn flipped backwards and dashed forwards.
